'''Fleet Headquarters''' was the headquarters of the [[New Republic Defense Fleet/Legends|New Republic Defense Fleet]] and was located on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. It was shaped like a dome. The headquarters had an on-site recruiting office, which including a waiting room, screening room and interview rooms. It also had an office for the recruiting supervisor and the [[War Hall]].<ref name="Shield of Lies" />
